title: LA Colossal – Celadon Sanggam 04 (Seated)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Korean woman in her mid-20s, sleek high ponytail with a jade clasp, natural face with a playful smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the maru, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Goryeo celadon body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. High-gloss jade-green celadon glaze clearly covering all skin, fine crackle and soft uneven reflections, black-and-white sanggam cranes, clouds, and ripples. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned. Authentic Korean Goryeo style.

Pose: Seated on the edge of a wooden maru, leaning back slightly with both hands planted behind her, chest open and belly relaxed forward, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch celadon-glazed platform stiletto thong sandals with a white crane toe ring and a slim ankle strap.
Nails: Extra long almond nails, celadon with white crane tips.

Background & Lighting: Hanok room with paper lattice doors and a white moon jar, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Soft window light with warm raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
